name: gb1
style: Flat 2D side view illustration from a children's picture book about giant prehistoric mammals. {subject}, the whole animal visible, cute and friendly with a happy face, isolated and centered on a solid uniform pure chroma-key magenta (#FF00FF) background. No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only. Every colour has a second, slightly darker flat shade on its lower or shadow side, giving a simple two-tone shading. Clean simple shapes. No pink, purple or magenta anywhere on the animal. No text, no ground, no grass, no shadow, no scenery.

items.paraceratherium: A single Paraceratherium standing on four legs facing right seen from the side, an enormous hornless rhinoceros with very long legs and a long neck, a long head with a short trunk-like lip, grey wrinkled skin
items.deinotherium: A single Deinotherium standing on four legs facing right seen from the side, a huge elephant relative with a short trunk and two big curved tusks pointing down from its lower jaw, grey wrinkled skin, big ears
items.andrewsarchus: A single Andrewsarchus standing on four legs facing right seen from the side, a big prehistoric mammal like a giant wolf with a very long big head and long jaws, short legs, a long tail, dark brown fur
items.entelodon: A single Entelodon standing on four legs facing right seen from the side, a big prehistoric pig-like animal with long legs, a big long head with bony bumps on its cheeks, a hump on its shoulders, bristly dark brown fur
items.chalicotherium: A single Chalicotherium standing facing right seen from the side, a strange horse-like animal with very long front legs with big curved claws and short back legs, a gorilla-like sloping back, a horse-like head, brown fur
items.megacerops: A single Megacerops brontothere standing on four legs facing right seen from the side, a huge rhino-like animal with a big Y-shaped blunt horn on the end of its nose, a big hump on its shoulders, grey brown skin
